SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT
S. S. R. 12.
A. D. 9290
(0 11 47)
Station...S-3...Foreign Affairs... File No.................... Date...27-9-45...

SUBJECT:

（批：(一)要视察名闻义）

Information has been received by the undersigned
regarding the activities of a Hungarian---S.SILMAN
owner of the Hungarian Inn, in YuYuen Road.
Mr. Silman was formerly a Jesuit Priest connected
with the Brotherhood of Jesuits in Changsha.
During his stay in Changsha about four years ago,
Mr. Silman was very well connected with Chungking Govt.
officials and was to be seen very often in the company
of prominent Chinese.
After the first bombardment of Changsha by the
Japanese Army, Silman managed to run away from the monas-
tery in which he was residing and came to Shanghai.
Upon his arrival in Shanghai, Silman who was without any
money went to see his old acquaintance who at the time
was the owner of the Hungarian Inn in Yu Yuen Road. They
were later married and Silman decided to remain in
Shanghai and give up his priesthood. In the record of
the Jesuit Brotherhood, however, Silman is still regarded
as a Jesuit Priest, although he ran away from his mon-
astery.

（印：FILE）

In Shanghai at present, Silman has many acquain-
tances among Chinese (Nanking) Government officials and
when they visit his restaurant in YuYuen Road he has
long talk with them regarding the situation. He is said
to be pro-British and has a very good knowledge of poli-
tics.

（印：DATE / IND. / REGISTRY / (B.) / DATE (0/11/47)）

Morris Guthrie

分局……S-3……外事科……档案号………………日期……1945年9月27日……

事由：

（批：(一)要视察名闻义）

下述签署人收到关于一名匈牙利人——S.SILMAN（西尔曼）活动的情报，此人是愚园路“匈牙利饭店”（Hungarian Inn）的业主。西尔曼先生此前是一名耶稣会神父，隶属于长沙的耶稣会兄弟会。大约四年前在长沙逗留期间，西尔曼先生与重庆政府官员关系密切，经常与知名中国人在一起被人看见。在日军首次轰炸长沙后，西尔曼设法从他居住的修道院逃离并来到上海。抵达上海时，身无分文的西尔曼去拜访了他的一位老相识，此人当时是愚园路“匈牙利饭店”的业主。两人后来结婚，西尔曼决定留在上海并放弃神职。然而，在耶稣会兄弟会的记录中，尽管西尔曼逃离了修道院，他仍被视为一名耶稣会神父。

（印：FILE [归档]）

目前在上海，西尔曼在中国（南京）政府官员中有许多熟人，当他们光顾他在愚园路的餐馆时，他会与他们就局势进行长谈。据说他亲英，并且对政治有非常深入的了解。

（印：DATE / IND. / REGISTRY / (B.) / DATE (0/11/47)）

Morris Guthrie

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No............
C. S. S. Special Branch
REPORT
Date May 4, 1940,
Subject (in full) Attached Newspaper Cutting from the North China Daily News.

Made by D.P.S. Danemanis,    Forwarded by Supt. Mason.

With reference to the attached cutting from
the North China Daily News dated 2-5-40, the following
have been obtained:-
The person responsible for the advertisement is
Miss S.S.SILMAN, Hungarian, licensee of the "Hungarian
Inn" at 272-4 Yu Yuen Road. Miss Silman leased the
"Cafe Courot" in Tsingtao, for the duration of the
summer season, and is going to operate it on similar
lines to the "Hungarian Inn".
The advertiser intends to engage a dance team of
four foreign girls, to put on a floor show at the above
cafe in Tsingtao.

D. F. S.

D.C. ( Special Branch ).

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No............
 Bubbling Well Station, /2/0
 REPORT
 Date July 31st. 19 39

Subject (in full) Hungarian Restaurant, 272 Yu Yuen Road.

Made by and Forwarded by Chief Inspector Dudley.

Sir,
 Premises were visited at 10 p.m. 29/7/39, and
"Bingo" was in progress, and appeared to be conducted in
an orderly and quiet manner.
 The premises are situated O.O.L. and are licensed.
 The proprietor was informed that the Police
objected to "Bingo" on the premises, and she referred to
other establishments on Yu Yuen Road, which are allowed
to have the facilities.
 She stated she had lost quite a lot of money since
opening the restaurant, and assured the undersigned that
she was willing to assist the Police in seeing that the
noise was kept to the lowest so as not to cause a nuisance
to the residents of the flats above.

 I am, Sir,
 Yours obediently.
（签名）
 officer-in-charge.

（印：FILED R 18）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案号…………
                                静安寺分局，/2/0
            报告                日期 1939年7月31日

事由（全称）愚园路272号匈牙利餐馆。

由督察长 Dudley 制作并转呈。

先生，
 premises 于1939年7月29日晚上10点受到视察，当时正在进行“宾果”（Bingo）游戏，且似乎以有序和安静的方式进行。
该场所位于 O.O.L.（注：原文缩写，可能指特定区域或许可类型），并持有执照。
店主被告知警方反对在该场所进行“宾果”游戏，她则提及愚园路上的其他 establishments（场所），那些地方被允许提供此类设施。
她表示自开设餐馆以来损失了不少钱，并向签署人保证，她愿意协助警方将噪音控制在最低限度，以免给楼上公寓的居民造成滋扰。

此致，
敬礼。
（签名）
主管警官。

（印：FILED R 18）

Made by. and Forwarded by. Inspector McFarlane.

D.L.
(Division)

manual or

Yu-Yuen Rd.
there are
numerous places
of entertainment
in respect of

"Bingo" is played
in almost all

premises.
Above 272 is a
block of flats
& there is every
possibility of
complaints of noise from the tenants of these flats. One
more attempt to dissuade the licensee from conducting
"Bingo" will be made & if unsuccessful, we can then
await developments & take drastic action if necessary. R.H.

Sir,
 With reference to the attached, I beg to report
having made enquiries in re and to having paid visits
to the place in question.
 The Hungarian Restaurant is owned and conducted
by a hungarian named Mrs. Sztella S. Stilmann, alias
Mrs. S. Stella Szirmay (This person has a record at
Headquarters).
 The place at 272 Yu Yuen Road is licensed as a
Tavern (S.M.C. Licence No.56).
 Recently business has been very bad, and the
proprietrix decided to open a "Bingo" game in an effort
to attract customers.
 In the current issue of the North China Daily
News for 14/7/39, she advertised for a croupier with a
knowledge of this game and as a result she is now employ-
ing a Chinese named Tsai Yuen nai (蔡元耐), who was
formerly employed as a croupier at the Welcome Cafe,
1457 Yu Yuen Road.
 It is believed that the "Bingo" game will be
commenced during the coming week-end.
 It is also to be noted that there are two jack-
pot machines in operation at this address.
 Enquiries at the station ascertained that early
this year there were frequent complaints received
regarding noise nuisance at this place, but none have
been received during recent months.

极有可能收到这些公寓租户关于噪音的投诉。将再尝试一次劝阻持照人经营“宾果”游戏，如果不成功，我们可以随后等待事态发展，并在必要时采取严厉行动。R.H.

先生，
关于附件，谨报告我已就此进行调查并访问了相关场所。
匈牙利餐馆由一名名为 Sztella S. Stilmann 夫人的匈牙利人拥有和经营，别名 S. Stella Szirmay 夫人（此人在总部有档案记录）。
愚园路272号的场所作为酒馆持有执照（工部局执照编号56）。
最近生意很差，女店主决定开设“宾果”游戏以吸引顾客。
在1939年7月14日出版的当期《字林西报》上，她刊登广告招聘熟悉该游戏的荷官，因此她目前雇佣了一名名叫蔡元耐的中国人，此人此前曾在愚园路1457号的 Welcome Cafe（欢迎咖啡馆）担任荷官。
据信，“宾果”游戏将在即将到来的周末开始。
另需注意，该地址有两台头奖机（jackpot machines）正在运行。
经向分局查询得知，今年早些时候曾频繁收到关于该场所噪音滋扰的投诉，但近几个月未收到此类投诉。

REPORT

File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. D. REGISTRY
No. S. 11. D.
Date June 27, 1939

Subject (in full) Miss Stella SZIRMAY.

Made by and Forwarded by Inspector Papp.

According to information received, Miss Stella
SZIRMAY, the proprietress of the Hungarian Inn, 272 Yu Yuen
Road, is now engaged in the organization of a troupe of
cabaret entertainers, at the head of which, she intends to
visit British India and the Dutch East Indies during the
period between July and October, returning here in the
Autumn to resume the management of her establishment at 272
Yu Yuen Road.

Papp.
Inspector.

D.C. (Special Branch).

（左侧手写批注：see also）
